stack_layers.description: The v0 Hyperion-Flux front-end pairs the app router with Space Grotesk theming, Zustand state, and shadcn/ui primitives so ops data streams render instantly.
server/src/app.module.ts wires modules for auth, modules, roadmap, security, docs, and payments with Prisma + Neon connectivity.
Events gateway streams simulation ticks, health pings, and alerts via server/src/websockets/events.gateway.ts and the paired module.
The Prisma schema and SQL seeds encode subscriptions, roadmap stages, and doc metadata so the merged control room inherits production tables.

stages.detail: Stage 0 seeds the digital-twin backlog and forks forge starter kits.
Stage 1 connects Sentinel Mesh to the forge PQC lab for baseline trust charts.
Stage 2 ingests forge notebooks to harden Wasm modules.
Stage 3 runs swarm rehearsals with Twin Reactor and ForgeOps Studio.
Stage 4 links Helios Telemetry into Chronicle Ledger for zk-audits.
Stage 5 ships Flux Orchestrator playbooks to the forge automation lane.
Stage 6 validates zero-knowledge releases for every module pair.
Stage 7 crowds tests PQC meshes with partner labs.
Stage 8 green-lights global deployment with forge-wrapped runbooks.
Stage 9 loops telemetry back into the forge backlog for continuous hardening.
